description: This file defines API interaction functions for fetching project data, metrics, and suggestions, including environment-based URL resolution and seed data fallback.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API calls based on environment variables or window location.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request to fetch JSON data from a specified path.

methods.name: seedProjects
methods.description: Provides default project list data if API fetch fails.

methods.name: seedMetrics
methods.description: Provides default metrics data for a project if API fetch fails.

methods.name: seedSuggestions
methods.description: Provides default suggestions data for a project if API fetch fails.

methods.name: fetchProjects
methods.description: Fetches list of projects from API or returns seeded data on failure.

methods.name: fetchMetrics
methods.description: Fetches metrics for a specific project or returns seeded data on failure.

methods.name: fetchSuggestions
methods.description: Fetches suggestions for a specific project or returns seeded data on failure.

methods.name: getResolvedApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the resolved API base URL for diagnostics.
